item.description:
OpenRamble 0.6.1

Benchmark correction (2026-08-14): the original cross-app timing used asymmetric measurement boundaries and too few block-ordered repeats. The 13.4× Handy comparison is retired and must not be cited as a fair benchmark. The scheduler improvement remains; a replacement comparison will use persistent paired processes, identical predecoded audio, interleaved repetitions, and per-run quality checks.

Long recordings finish sooner. OpenRamble now evaluates the optional acoustic-vocabulary model only on windows that can affect the final text while preserving overlap behavior.

Cancellation stays contained. Cancelling transcription drains speculative vocabulary work before the request returns.
